name: equipment-webapp
description: Single-page app for staff to browse equipment and manage their own loans, and for the office manager to maintain the inventory and track what is out and overdue. Screens are gated by role. Holds no business logic of its own — all data comes from equipment-api.

dependencies.name: equipment-api
dependencies.description: All equipment and loan data and actions.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs staff and the office manager in through the organization's SSO.
